current_grouping: Subpart G — Operating Limitations And Information

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G — Operating Limitations And Information
versions.text:
The minimum flight crew must be established so that it is sufficient for safe operation considering –
(a) The workload on individual crew members and, in addition for commuter category aeroplanes, each crew member workload determination must consider the following:
  (1) Flight path control,
  (2) Collision avoidance,
  (3) Navigation,
  (4) Communications,
  (5) Operation and monitoring of all essential aeroplane systems,
  (6) Command decisions, and
  (7) The accessibility and ease of operation of necessary controls by the appropriate crew member during all normal and emergency operations when at the crew member flight station.
(b) The accessibility and ease of operation of necessary controls by the appropriate crew member; and
(c) The kinds of operation authorised under CS 23.1525.
